Yoruba: Ọgbọ̀n ẹ̀yà-ẹ̀dá abirunlára, àwọn ẹye, àwọn afàyàfà àti  àwọn agbélẹ̀-gbómi ni wọ́n lérò pé wọ́n dé láàrin ọdun 10,000 sẹ́yìn, tí ìdá méjì nínú mẹ́ta wọn sì ti di aláfagbárajáwọ̀ láàrin ọdún 150 sẹ́yìn.

Amharic: በ2020ው የመፅሃፍ ምእራፍ ላይ፣ ወደ 30 የሚጠጉ የእንግዳ አካል እንስሳት ዝርያዎች ከሌላ ቦታ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ እንደተዋወቁ፣ እና አንዳንዶቹ በኢኮኖሚ እና በአካባቢ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ ነው ብለዋል ሳይንቲስቶቹ።

English: Researchers and authorities could use his information to help control the spread of these invasive birds, mammals, reptiles and frogs.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza n’aboobuyinza basobola okukozesa obubaka buno okuyamba okukendeeza ku kusaasaana kw’ebinyonyi, ebisolo ebiyonsa, ebyewalula n’ebikere bino eby’obulabe.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí àti àwọn aláṣẹ́ lè lo àlàyé yìí láti se ìrànwọ́ fún kíkápá ìtànkálẹ̀ àwọn ẹyẹ aláfagbárajáwọ̀, àwọn abirunlára, àwọn afàyàfà àti àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi neziphathimandla bangasebenzisa ukwaziswa kwakhe ukuze basize ekulawuleni ukusakazeka kwalezi zinyoni ezihlaselayo, izilwane ezincelisayo, izilwane ezihuquzelayo namaxoxo.
Hausa: Masu bincike da hukumomi za su iya amfani da bayanansa don taimakawa wajen shawo kan yaɗuwar waɗannan tsuntsaye da dabbobi masu jan-jiki da kuma kwaɗi masu mamaya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši le balaodi ba ka šomiša tshedimošo ye go thuša go laola go phatlalala ga dinonyana, diamuši, digagadi le digwagwa tša go šwahlela.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች እና ባለስልጣናት ይህንን መረጃ የእነዚህን ወራሪ ወፎች፣ አጥቢ እንስሳት፣ ተሳቢ እንስሳት እና እንቁራሪቶች ስርጭትን ለመቆጣጠር ሊጠቀሙበት ይችላሉ።

English: ‘Invasive species’ are organisms that are introduced into a new area that they are not native to.
Luganda: ‘Ebitonde ebirumbaganyi’bye bitonde ebireetebwa mu kitundu ekipya mwe bitali binnansangwa.
Yoruba: ‘ẹ̀yà-ẹ̀dá aláfagbárajáwọ̀’ jẹ àwọn ẹ̀dá tí wọ́n mú wọ agbègbè tuntun tí wọn kì í ṣe ibùgbé-ìpìlẹ̀ wọn.
Zulu: ‘Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo’ yizinto eziphilayo ezethulwa endaweni entsha ezingazalelwa kuzo.
Hausa: ‘Jinsuna masu mamayewa’ halittu ne da aka shigo da su cikin wani sabon yanki da ba na asali ba.
Northern Sotho: ‘Mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela’ ke diphedi tšeo di tlišwago tikologong ye mpsha yeo di sa e tlwaelago ka ge ka tlhago ya tšona di sa hlage moo.
Amharic: ‘ወራሪ ዝርያዎች’ ተወላጅ ባልሆኑበት አዲስ አካባቢ ውስጥ የተዋወቁ ፍጥረታት ናቸው።

English: These non-native aliens may thrive at the expense of native species and harm the native ecosystem.
Luganda: Ebitonde bino ebitali binnansangwa biyinza okunyigiriza ebitonde binnansangwa ne bikosa obutonde bw’ebitundu ebyo.
Yoruba: Àwọn àjòjì tí wọn kì í se ohun ibùgbé-ìpìlẹ̀ yìí ní àkóbá fún àwọn ẹ̀yà-ẹ̀dá tí wọ́n fi ibẹ̀ ṣe ilé tí wọ́n sì ń ṣàkóbá fún àpapọ̀ ibùgbé.
Zulu: Lezi zilwane ezingezona ezomdabu zingase ziphumelele ngenxa yezindleko zezinhlobo zomdabu futhi zilimaze i-ecosystem yomdabu.
Hausa: Waɗannan baƙi waɗanda ba na asali ba suna iya bunƙasa ta hanyar kashe jinsuna ‘yan asalin kuma suna cutar da yanayin muhalli na asali.
Northern Sotho: Diphedi tša go tšwa dinagengdišele di ka ikhweletša legae le lekaone go feta mehuta ya diphedi tša tlhago tša baka tshenyo go phedišano ya diphedi ya tlhago.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተወላጅ-ያልሆኑ እንግዳ አካላት የአገሬው ተወላጅ ዝርያዎችን መስዋዕት አድርገው ሊበለጽጉ እና የአገሬውን ስነ-ምህዳር ሊጎዱ ይችላሉ።

English: Researchers who have studied invasive species in South Africa have mostly worked with plants because their impacts are easy to notice, but information on invasive animals is still lacking.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abeetegerezza ebitonde ebirumbaganyi mu South Africa basinze kukola ku bimera kubanga bye bireetawo byangu okulaba, naye ebikwata ku bisolo ebirumbaganyi bikyali bitono.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n ti ṣe ìwádìí lórí àwọn ẹ̀yà-ẹ̀dá aláfagbárajáwọ̀ ní ilẹ̀ South Africa ni wọ́n ti sáábà fi ìrugbìn ṣe iṣẹ́ ṣe torí ó rọrùn láti rí ipa wọn, àmọ́ àlayé lórí àwọn ẹranko tí wọ́n fagbárakáká wọ̀lú ṣì mẹ́hẹ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abenze ucwaningo ngezilwane ezihlaselayo eNingizimu Afrika isikhathi esiningi basebenze nezitshalo ngoba imithelela yazo kulula ukuyibona, kodwa ulwazi ngezilwane ezihlaselayo lusasilele.
Hausa: Masu binciken da suka yi nazarin jinsuna masu mamayewa a Afirka ta Kudu galibi sun yi aiki ne a kan tsirrai saboda tasirin su yana da sauƙin lura, amma har yanzu ba a sami bayanai a kan dabbobi masu mamayewa ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši bao ba ithutilego ka mehuta ya diphedi tša go šwahlela  ka Afrika Borwa gantši ba šomile ka dimela ka baka la gore dikamego tša tšona di bonolo go lemogwa, eupša tshedimošo ka ga diphoofolo tša tša go šwahlela e dutše e hlokagala.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ወራሪ ዝርያዎችን ያጠኑ ተመራማሪዎች በአብዛኛው ከዕፅዋት ጋር ሠርተዋል ምክንያቱም ተጽኖአቸው በቀላሉ የሚታይ ነው፣ ነገር ግን ስለ ወራሪ እንስሳት ያለው መረጃ አሁንም ያጥራል።

English: In this chapter, the authors reviewed what scientists knew at the time regarding animals that had been introduced into South Africa from other countries.
Luganda: Mu ssuula eno, abanoonyereza beetegereza bannassaayansi bye baali bamanyi mu kiseera ekyo ku bisolo ebyali biyingidde mu South Africa okuva mu mawanga amalala.
Yoruba: Ní orí yìí, àwọn òǹkọ̀wé se àgbéyẹ̀wò ohun tí àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì mọ̀ ní àkókò náà nípa àwọn ẹranko tí wọ́n mú wọlé sí South Africa láti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè mìíràn.
Zulu: Kulesi sahluko, ababhali babuyekeze lokho ososayensi ababekwazi ngaleso sikhathi mayelana nezilwane ezafika eNingizimu Afrika zivela kwamanye amazwe.
Hausa: A wannan babi, marubutan sun yi bitar abin da masana kimiyya suka sani a lokacin game da dabbobin da aka shigo da su ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu daga wasu ƙasashe.
Northern Sotho: Ka kgaolong ye, bangwadi ba lekodišišitše tšeo ditsebi tša mahlale di bego di di tseba nakong yeo mabapi le le diphoofolo tše di tlišitšwego ka Afrika Borwa go tšwa  dinageng tše dingwe.
Amharic: በዚህ ምእራፍ፣ ደራሲዎቹ ሳይንቲስቶች ከሌሎች አገሮች ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ስለገቡ እንስሳትን በሚመለከት በወቅቱ የሚያውቁትን ገምግመዋል።

English: They found that 30 different species of mammals, birds, reptiles and amphibians (like frogs and toads) were introduced into South Africa over the previous 10 000 years.
Luganda: Baakizuula nti ebika 30 eby’ebisolo ebiyonsa, ebinyonyi, ebyewalula n’eby’omu mazzi (ng’ebikere) byayingizibwa mu South Africa mu myaka 10 000 egiyise.
Yoruba: Wọ́n rí pé ẹ̀yà-ẹ̀dá 30 ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ tí ó abirunlára, àwọn ẹyẹ, àwọn afàyàfà àti agbélẹ̀-gbómi (bíi ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ àti kọ̀nkọ̀) ni wọ́n mú wọ South Africa láàrin 10 000 years sẹ́yìn.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi izinhlobo ezingama-30 ezahlukene zezilwane ezincelisayo, izinyoni, izilwane ezihuquzelayo kanye nezilwane ezihlala emanzini (njengamaxoxo namaxoxo) zangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika eminyakeni eyizi-10 000 edlule.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa an shigo da jinsunan dabbobi masu shayarwa da tsuntsaye da da dabbobi masu jan-jiki da kuma dangunan kwaɗi guda 30 mabambanta (kamar kwaɗi) cikin ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu a cikin shekaru 10 000 da suka gabata.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše mehuta ye e fapafapanego ye 30 ya diamuši, dinonyana, digagadi le  diamfipia (go swana le digwagwa) di tlišitšwe ka Afrika Borwa mo mengwageng ye e fetilego ye 10 000.
Amharic: ባለፉት 10 000 ዓመታት ውስጥ 30 የተለያዩ አጥቢ እንስሳት፣ ወፎች፣ ተሳቢ እንስሳት እና አምፊናሎች ዝርያዎች (እንደ እንቁራሪቶች እና ጉርጦች) ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ እንደገቡ ደርሰውበታል።

English: Interestingly, 2 out of 3 of those became invasive, or harmful, in the last 150 years.
Luganda: Ekyewuunyisa, ebika 2 ku 3 ku bino byafuuka ebirumbaganyi, oba eby’obulabe mu myaka 150 egiyise.
Yoruba: Ni èyí tí ó yani lẹ́nu, 2 nínú 3 àwọn wọ̀nyí ni wọ́n di aláfagbárajáwọ̀ tàbi kí wọ́n burú, láàrin ọdún 150 sẹ́yìn.
Zulu: Ngokuthakazelisayo, ezi-2 kwezi-3 zalezo ziye zahlasela, noma zaba yingozi, eminyakeni engu-150 edlule.
Hausa: Abin sha’awa, 2 a cikin 3 na waɗannan sun zama masu mamayewa, ko cutarwa, a cikin shekaru 150 da suka gabata.
Northern Sotho: Sa go kgahliša, mehuta ye 2 go ye 3 ya diphoofolo tše, di bakile tlhobaetšo, goba kotsi, mo mengwageng ye e fetilego ye 150.
Amharic: የሚገርመው፣ ባለፉት 150 ዓመታት ውስጥ፣ ከ3ቱ 2ቱ ወራሪ፣ ወይም ጎጂ ሆነዋል።

English: Half of the species were mammals, a third were birds, with 3 reptiles and 2 amphibians.
Luganda: Kimu kyakubiri eky’ebika bino byali bisolo ebiyonsa, kimu kyakusatu byali binyonyi, nga 3 byali byewalula ate nga 2 bya mu mazzi.
Yoruba: Ìdajì nínú àwọn ẹ̀yà-ẹ̀dá náà jẹ́ ẹ̀dá abirunlára, ìdá kan nínú mẹ́ta jẹ àwọn ẹyẹ, àwọn afàyàfà 3, àti agbélẹ̀-gbómi 2.
Zulu: Ingxenye yalezi zinhlobo kwakuyizilwane ezincelisayo, ingxenye yesithathu kwakuyizinyoni, nezilwane ezihuquzelayo ezi-3 kanye nezi-2 ezihlala emanzini nasemanzini.
Hausa: Rabin su jinsunan dabbobi masu shayarwa ne, na uku kuma tsuntsaye ne, tare da dabbobi masu jan-jiki guda 3 da kuma dangunan kwaɗi guda 2.
Northern Sotho: Seripagare sa mehuta yeo e bile diamuši, teetharong e bile dinonyana, le digagadi tše 3 le diamfipia tše 2.
Amharic: ከዝርያዎቹ ውስጥ ግማሹ አጥቢ እንስሳት፣ አንድ ሶስተኛው ወፎች፣ 3 ተሳቢ እንስሳት እና 2 አምፊናሎች ነበሩ።

English: The authors said mammals introduced included domestic animals like pigs, cats, goats, donkeys and horses.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti ebisobolo ebiyonsa ebyaleetebwa mwalimu ensolo z’awaka ng’embizzi, kkapa, embuzi, endogoyi n’embalaasi.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà sọ pé lára àwọn ẹ̀dá abirunlára ni àwọn ẹranko bíi ẹlẹ́dẹ̀, olóńgbò, ewúrẹ́, kẹ́tẹ́kẹ́tẹ́ àti àwọn ẹṣin.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi izilwane ezincelisayo ezethulwe zihlanganisa izilwane ezifuywayo njengezingulube, amakati, izimbuzi, izimbongolo namahhashi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce dabbobi masu shayarwa da aka gabatar sun haɗa da dabbobin gida kamar aladu da maguna da awaki da jakuna da kuma dawakai.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore diamuši tše di tlišitšwego di akareditše diphoofolo tša gae tše bjalo ka dikolobe, dikatse, dipudi, ditonki le dipere.
Amharic: የተዋወቁት አጥቢ የቤት እንሰሳት እንደ አሳማ፣ ድመቶች፣ ፍየሎች፣ አህዮች እና ፈረሶችን ያካትታል ብለዋል ደራሲዎቹ።

English: Mammals are animals that feed their babies with milk from their mammary glands.
Luganda: Ensolo eziyonsa zeezo eziriisa abaana baazo amata g’amabeere gaazo.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀dá abirunlára àwọn ẹranko tí wọ́n máa ń fún ọmọ wọn ní wàrà láti àyà wọn.
Zulu: Izilwane ezincelisayo ziyizilwane ezondla izingane zazo ngobisi oluvela ezindlala zebele.
Hausa: Dabbobi masu shayarwa dabbobi ne da suke shayar da jariransu madara daga nonnansu.
Northern Sotho: Diamuši ke diphoofolo tšeo di fepago bana ba tšona ka maswi go tšwa go dithaka tša matswele a tšona.
Amharic: አጥቢ እንስሳት ልጆቻቸውን ከወተት እጢዎቻቸው ወተት የሚመገቡ እንስሳት ናቸው።

English: The animals were introduced for food (pigs, goats) and transport (donkeys and horses), but were later problematic.
Luganda: Ebisolo byaleetebwa olw’okuliibwa (embizzi, embuzi) n’okutambuza (endogoyi n’embalaasi), naye oluvannyuma byafuuka bya mutawaana.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mú àwọn ẹranko náà wọlé fún ẹran (ẹlẹ́dẹ̀, ewúrẹ́) àti fún ìrìnnà (kẹ́tẹ́kẹ́tẹ́ àti ẹṣin), ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n padà di ìṣoro.
Zulu: Izilwane zethulwa ukudla (izingulube, izimbuzi) kanye nokuthutha (izimbongolo namahhashi), kodwa kamuva zaba yinkinga.
Hausa: An gabatar da dabbobin ne domin abinci (aladu da awaki) da kuma jigilar kaya (jakuna da dawakai), amma daga baya sun zama matsala.
Northern Sotho: Diphoofolo di be di tlišitšwe bjalo ka dijo (dikolobe, dipudi) le dinamelwa (ditonki le dipere), eupša mafelelong tša baka mathata.
Amharic: እንስሳቱ ለምግብ (አሳማዎች፣ ፍየሎች) እና ለመጓጓዣ (አህዮች እና ፈረሶች) ገብተዋል፣ ነገር ግን በኋላ ላይ ችግር ተፈጠረ።

English: For example, cats now feed on other animals, and donkeys mate with zebras.
Luganda: Okugeza, kkapa kati zirya ensolo endala, ate endogoyi zeegatta ne zebula.
Yoruba: Bí àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn olóńgbò ti wá ń je àwọn ẹranko mìíràn báyìí, àwọn kẹ́tẹ́kẹ́tẹ́ sì ti ń gun àwọn ẹṣin abilà.
Zulu: Ngokwesibonelo, amakati manje adla ezinye izilwane, kanti izimbongolo zihlangana namadube.
Hausa: Alal misali, maguna yanzu suna cin wasu dabbobi, jakuna kuma suna saduwa da jakunan dawa.
Northern Sotho: Mohlala, dikatse gabjale di ja diphoofolo tše dingwe, mola ditonki di tsenela tša thobalano le dipitsi.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ አሁን ድመቶች ሌሎች እንስሳትን ይመገባሉ፣ እና አህዮች ከሜዳ አህዮች ጋር ይጣመራሉ።

English: Wild mammals such as roan antelope, sambar deer, himalayan tahr, European rabbits, rats (brown and Asian), and grey squirrels had been introduced as well.
Luganda: Ensolo z’omu nsiko ng’engabi, sambar deer, himalayan tahr, obumyu obuzungu, emigunju, n’obutulumi obwa kivuuvu nazo zaaleetebwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀dá abirunlára tí wọ́n figbó ṣe ilé bí màsìà, egbin, ehoro ilẹ̀ Europe àti àwọn èkúté (pupa rẹ́ṣúrẹ́ṣú àti ti ilẹ̀ Asia), àti àwọn ọ̀kẹ́rẹ́ náà ti di mímú wọlé.
Zulu: Izilwane ezincelisayo zasendle njenge-roan antelope, sambar deer, i-himalayan tahr, onogwaja base-Europe, amagundane (amagundane ansundu nama-Asian), kanye nezingwejeje ezimpunga nazo.
Hausa: An kuma gabatar da dabbobi masu shayarwa irin su gwanki da barewar sambar da tahr na himalaya da zomayen Turai da ɓeraye (ruwan ƙasa da Asiya), da kuma kuregu masu launin toka.
Northern Sotho: Diamuši tša lešoka tše bjalo ka diphalafala tša tšhakgahla, dikgama, himalayan tahr, mebutla ya Yuropa, magotlo (a sotho le a Asia), le dihlora le tšona di ile tša tlišwa ka nageng.
Amharic: እንደ የጉሎ ድኩላ፣ የሳምባር አጋዘን፣ የሂማሊያ ታህሮች፣ የአውሮፓ ጥንቸሎች፣ አይጦች (ቡናማ እና የእስያ) እና ግራጫ ሽኮኮዎች ያሉ አጥቢ የዱር እንስሳትም ገብተዋል።

English: The authors said some like the antelopes, were intentionally introduced, while others, like mice, were introduced accidentally through shipping.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti ezimu ng’engabi, zaaleetebwa mu bugenderevu, naye endala ng’emmese, zaaleetebwa mu butanwa nga zijjira mu migumu.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé sọ pé àwọn kan bí àgbọ̀nrín, ni wọ́n mọ̀-ọ́n-mọ̀ mú wọlé, nígbà tí àwọn yòókù, bí èkúté, ni wọ́n ṣèèṣì mú wọlé nípasẹ̀ ìfọkọ̀ ojú-omi gbé nǹkan wọlé.
Zulu: Ababhali bathi ezinye ezifana nezinhlwathi, zethulwe ngamabomu, kanti ezinye, njengamagundane, zafakwa ngephutha ngemikhumbi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun ce da gangan aka bullo da wasu kamar tururuwa, yayin da wasu kamar beraye aka bullo da su cikin bazata ta hanyar jigilar kaya.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše gore tše dingwe tše di swanago le diphalafala, di tlišitšwe ka maikemišetšo, mola tše dingwe, tše bjalo ka magotlo, di tlišitšwe ka phošo di sepetšwa ka dikepe.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ እንዳሉት አንዳንዶቹ እንደ ድኩላ፣ ሆን ተብሎ ተዋውቀዋል፣ ሌሎች ደግሞ፣ እንደ አይጥ ያሉት፣ በአጋጣሚ በመርከብ የገቡ ናቸው።

English: Rabbits were intentionally introduced for their meat, but their numbers grew such that they became difficult to control.
Luganda: Obumyu bwaleetebwa mu bugenderevu olw’ennyama yaabwo, naye omuwendo gwabwo gweyongera ne bufuuka buzibu okukendeeza.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mọ̀-ọ́n-mọ̀ mú ehoro wọlé nítorí eran ara wọn, ṣùgbọ́n iye wọn pọ̀ débi pé o nira láti ṣàkóso wọn.
Zulu: Onogwaja bethulwa ngamabomu ukuze bathole inyama yabo, kodwa inani labo lakhula kangangokuthi kwaba nzima ukubalawula.
Hausa: An gabatar da zomaye da gangan domin namansu, amma adadinsu ya ƙaru har ya zama da wahala a iya shawo kan su.
Northern Sotho: Mebutla e tlišitšwe ka maikemišetšo ka baka la nama ya tšona, eupša palo ya tšona ya atafala ka tsela yeo e lego gore go bile boima go e laola.
Amharic: ጥንቸሎች ሆን ተብሎ ለሥጋቸው ሲባል ይተዋወቁ ነበር፣ ነገር ግን ቁጥራቸው እያደገ በመምጣቱ ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኑ።

English: Others, like rodents, threatened food production and transmitted diseases.
Luganda: Endala, ng’emmese, zaakendeeza emmere ekungulwa era ne zisaasaanya endwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn yòókù, bí ajẹlójú onílé, ti ń ṣàkóbá fún ìpèsè oúnjẹ tí wọ́n sì ń ran ìtànká àrùn lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Okunye, njengokusamagundane, kusongela ukukhiqizwa kokudla kanye kuphinde kudlulise nezifo.
Hausa: Saura, kamar dangunan ɓeraye, suna barazanar samar da abinci da kuma cututtuka masu yaɗuwa.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe, go swana le mehuta ya magotlo, di bile le matšhošetši go tšweletšo ya dijo le tša phatlalatša le malwetši.
Amharic: ሌሎች፣ እንደ ፍልፈሎች፣ ለምግብ ምርት እና ለሚተላለፉ በሽታዎች አስግተዋል።

English: In some cases, invasive animals like rats outcompeted the native animals and pushed them out of their natural environments.
Luganda: Ebiseera ebimu, ebisolo ebirumbaganyi ng’emmese zaasinga binnansangwa obungi ne bibisindiikiriza okuva mu bitundu mwe byali bibeera.
Yoruba: Ní àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ mìíràn, àwọn ẹranko aláfagbárajáwọ̀ bí èkúté fígagbága wón sì borí àwọn ẹranko ti wọ́n fibẹ̀ ṣe ibùgbé ìpìlẹ̀ wọn wọ́n sì tì wọ́n kúrò ni àyíká ibi tí wọ́n dá wọn sí.
Zulu: Kwezinye izimo, izilwane ezihlaselayo njengamagundane zazidlula izilwane zomdabu futhi zazikhipha endaweni yazo yemvelo.
Hausa: A wasu lokutan, dabbobi masu mamayewa ɓeraye sun fi dabbobin ƙasar kuma sun fitar da su daga muhallinsu na asali.
Northern Sotho: Ka nako tše dingwe, diphoofolo tša go šwahlela tše bjalo ka magotlo di hlalefeditše diphoofolo tša tlhago le go di huduša go ditikologo tša tšona tša tlhago.
Amharic: በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች፣ እንደ አይጥ ያሉ ወራሪ እንስሳት ተፈጥሯዊ አካባቢያቸው ከሆነው ከአገሬው ተወላጅ እንሰሳት ጋር መወዳደራቸው እንዲወጡ አድርጓቸዋል።

English: The authors also said birds such as mallards, house sparrows, chafﬁnches, chukar partridges, pigeons, starlings and common mynas, house crows and peacocks had been deliberately introduced to South Africa.
Luganda: Abawandiisi era baagamba nti ebinyonyi nga mallards, enkusu, obusanke, enkwale, enjiibwa, enkwenge ne common mynas, namuŋŋoona ne nnyonyimuzinge byaleetebwa mu bugenderevu mu South Africa.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà tún sọ pé àwọn ẹyẹ bíi pẹ́pẹ́yẹ igbó, ológoṣẹ́, àparò, ẹyẹẹlé, kannakánná àti àọn ẹye ọ̀kín ni wọ́n ti mọ̀-ọ́n-mọ̀ mú wọ South Africa.
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde bathi izinyoni ezinjengama-mallards, ondlunkulu, amakhoba, ama-chukar partridges, amajuba, ama-starlings nama-common mynas, amagwababa asekhaya namapigogo angeniswe ngamabomu eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma ce da gangan aka gabatar da tsuntsaye irin su agwagwar ruwa da gwara na gida da chaffinches da chukar partridges da tattabaru da starlings da mynas gama-gari da hankakan gida da ɗawisu a ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše le gore dinonyana tše bjalo ka mapidipidi a hlogotalamorogo, diphorogohlo tša gae, chafﬁnches, chukar partridges, maeba, ditheku le common mynas, magokobu a ka ntlong le diphikoko di tlišitšwe ka maikemišetšo ka Afrika Borwa.
Amharic: እንደ ማላርድ፣ የቤት ድንቢጦች፣ ገለባ፣ ቹካር ጅግራ፣ ርግቦች፣ ስታርሊንጎች እና ተራ ማይናዎች፣ የቤት ቁራዎች እና ጣዎስ ያሉ ወፎች ሆን ተብሎ ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ እንደተዋወቁ ደራሲዎቹ ተናግረዋል።

English: Some were brought in as pets or for sporting purposes, and some destroyed crops and poultry, spread diseases, or competed with native birds.
Luganda: Ebimu byaleetebwa ng’ebyokukuuma mu nju oba okukozesebwa mu mizannyo, era ebimu byayonoona ebirime n’ebinyonyi, byasaasaanya endwadde, oba okuvuganya n’ebinyonyi binnansangwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mú àwọn mìíràn wọlé gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun ọ̀sìn àti fún eré-ìdárayá, àwọn mìíràn sì ba èso àti ilésìn adiẹ jẹ́, tan àrùn ká, tàbí kí wọ́n figagbága pẹ̀lú àwọn ẹye ìbílẹ̀.
Zulu: Abanye balethwa njengezilwane ezifuywayo noma ngenjongo yezemidlalo, kanti abanye bacekela phansi izitshalo nezinkukhu, basakaza izifo, noma baqhudelana nezinyoni zendabuko.
Hausa: An kawo wasu a matsayin dabbobin gida ko domin wasanni, wasu kuma sun lalata amfanin gona da kuma kaji da yaɗa cututtuka, ko yin gogayya da tsuntsayen gida.
Northern Sotho: Tše dingwe di tlišitšwe bjalo ka diruiwaratwa goba ka merero ya tša dipapadi, gomme tše dingwe di sentše dimela gomme dikgogo, di phatlaladitše malwetši, goba di hlalefeditše dinonyana tša tlhago.
Amharic: አንዳንዶቹ እንደ የቤት እንስሳት ወይም ለስፖርት ዓላማዎች ይመጡ ነበር፣ እና አንዳንዶቹ ሰብሎችን እና የዶሮ እርባታዎችን ያወድማሉ፣ በሽታዎችን ያሰራጫሉ፣ ወይም ከአገሬው ተወላጅ ወፎች ጋር ይወዳደሩ ነበር።

English: The authors also said reptiles such as corn snakes, tropical house geckos, the common dwarf gecko, and the flowerpot snake were introduced into South Africa by mistake as eggs or as adults, but researchers had not studied their impact yet.
Luganda: Abawandiisi era baagamba nti ebyewalula ng’emisota, n’amakonkome byaleetebwa mu South Africa mu butanwa ng’amagi oba ng’ebisolo ebikuze, naye abanoonyereza baali tebanneetegereza bye bireeta.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà sọ pé àwọn afàyàfà bí ejò, ọmọọlé, ọmọọ́lé aràrá, àti ejò paramọ́lẹ̀ ni wọ́n ṣèèṣì mú wọ South Africa yálà ní ipò eyin tàbí èyí tí ó ti dàgbà, àmọ́ àwọn aṣèwádìí kò ti ṣàyẹ̀wò ipa wọn.
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde bathi izilwane ezihuquzelayo ezifana nezinyoka zommbila, i-tropical house geckos, i-common dwarf gecko, nenyoka yasebhodweni zezimbali zangeniswa eNingizimu Afrika ngephutha njengamaqanda noma sezikhulile, kodwa abacwaningi bebengakacwaningi ngomthelela wazo.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma ce an shigo da dabbobi masu jan-jiki irin su macijin-masara da tsaka ta wurare masu zafi da gajerar tsaka da ƙananan macizai zuwa Afirka ta Kudu bisa kuskure a matsayin ƙwai ko kuma a matsayin manya, amma masu binciken ba su yi nazarin tasirinsu ba tukuna.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba boletše le gore digagadi tše bjalo ka dinoga tša lehlka, mahopane a theropikhale, lehopane le lennyane, le noga ya ka pitšeng di tlišitšwe ka Afrika Borwa ka phošo e le mae goba e le tše kgolo, eupša banyakišiši ga se ba nyakišiša ka diabe tša tšona.
Amharic: እንደ የበቆሎ እባቦች፣ የሞቃታማ ቤት ጌኮዎች፣ የተለመደው ድንክዬ ጌኮ፣ እና የአበባ ማስቀመጫ እባብ ያሉ ተሳቢ እንሰሳት በስህተት ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ የገቡት እንደ እንቁላል ወይም እንደ ጎልማሳ ቢሆንም፣ ተመራማሪዎች ግን ተፅዕኖአቸውን እስካሁን አላጠናንም ብለዋል።

English: Apparently, some travellers might have introduced painted reed frogs and guttural toads deliberately into South Africa through some aquatic plants.
Luganda: Kirabika, abatambuze abamu bayinza okuba nga baaleeta ebikere ebimyufu ne guttural toads mu bugenderevu mu South Africa nga babireetera mu bimera by’omu mazzi.
Yoruba: Bí ó ṣe ti hàn, ó lè jẹ́ àwọn arìnrìn-àjò kan ni wọ́n mọ̀-ọ́n-mọ̀ mú àwọn ẹ̀yà ọ̀pọ̀lọ́ àti kọ̀ǹkọ̀ wọ South Africa nípasẹ̀ àwọn irúgbìn orí omi kọ̀ọ̀kan.
Zulu: Ngokusobala, abanye abahambi bangase bethule amaxoxo apendiwe ngomhlanga kanye namaxoxo asesiswini ngamabomu eNingizimu Afrika ngokusebenzisa izitshalo ezithile zasemanzini.
Hausa: A bayyane yake, wataƙila wasu matafiya sun gabatar da kwaɗi masu launi da kuma kwaɗi masu kuka da gangan cikin ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu ta hanyar wasu tsirrai na ruwa.
Northern Sotho: Go bonala, baeti ba bangwe ba ka ba ba tlišitše digwagwa tša lehlaka la go pentwa le matlapakgerere ka maikemišetšo ka Afrika Borwa ka tsela ya dibjalo tše dingwe tša ka meetseng.
Amharic: በግልጽ ለማየት እንደሚቻለው፣ አንዳንድ ተጓዦች በአንዳንድ የውኃ ውስጥ ተክሎች አማካኝነት ሆን ብለው የቀለመ መቃ እንቁራሪቶችን እና የጉሮሮ ጉርጦችን ወደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ አስገብተው ሊሆን ይችላል።

English: The authors expressed their worries that there was an increasing number of animals introduced into the country as pets.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baalaga okutya nti waaliwo omuwendo gw’ensolo ogweyongera oguleetebwa mu ggwanga okukuumwa awaka.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà fi àìbalẹ̀ ọkàn wọn hàn nípa pé iye àwọn ẹranko tí wọ́n ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ń kó wọ orílẹ̀-èdè náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohun ọ̀sìn ti ń pọ̀ síi.
Zulu: Ababhali bazwakalise ukukhathazeka kwabo ngokuthi liyakhula isibalo sezilwane ezilethwa kuleli njengezilwane ezifuywayo.
Hausa: Marubutan sun bayyana damuwarsu cewa ana samun karuwar dabbobin da aka shigar da su cikin kasar a matsayin dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba gateletše ditlhobaelo tša bona tša gore go bile le palo ye e hlatlogago ya diphoofolo tše di tlišwago ka nageng e le diruiwaratwa.
Amharic: ወደ አገሪቱ እንደ የቤት እንስሳት የሚገቡ እንስሳት ቁጥር እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ደራሲዎቹ ጭንቀታቸውን ገልጸዋል።

English: The authors, who were based in South Africa, hope this review brings together some of the information needed to better manage invasive animals in the country.
Luganda: Abawandiisi, nga baali bava mu South Africa, basuubira nti okwetegereza kuno kuleese wamu obubaka obwetaagisa mu kukwata obulungi ebisolo ebirumbaganyi mu ggwanga.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà, tí wọ́n fi orílẹ̀-èdè South Africa ṣe ibùdó, gbà á lérò pé àgbéyẹ̀wò yìí yóò ṣe àkójọ díè lára àwọn àlàyé tí wọ́n nílò láti túbọ̀ ṣakóso àwọn ẹranko agbààyè-panilára ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà.
Zulu: Ababhali, ababezinze eNingizimu Afrika, bathemba ukuthi lokhu kubuyekezwa kuzoletha ndawonye olunye ulwazi oludingekayo ukuze kulawuleke kangcono izilwane ezihlaselayo ezweni.
Hausa: Marubutan, waɗanda suke zaune a Afirka ta Kudu, suna fatan wannan bita ta haɗa wasu bayanan da ake buƙata domin ingantaccen shawo kan dabbobi masu mamayewa a cikin ƙasar yadda ya kamata.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi, bao ba bego ba le ka Afrika Borwa, ba hutša gore tekodišišo ye e kopanya gotee tše dingwe tša tshedimošo ye e hlokegago go laola bokaone diphoofolo tša go šwahlela ka nageng.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ ያሉት፣ ደራሲዎቹ፣ ይህ ግምገማ በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ ወራሪ እንስሳትን በተሻለ ሁኔታ ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስፈልጉትን አንዳንድ መረጃዎች እንደሚያመጣ ተስፋ አላቸው።
